decision: Connect the existing independently gated Files menu to a scoped synthetic directory provider and existing full-file preview interface. Preserve native return behavior and source-supported file navigation/loading containers. Exact layout remains separate.
host_gap: Files currently falls through to disconnected-service alert, although menu and source action already exist.

upstream.observation: fs/readDirectory and fs/readFile expose file/directory data. iOS293 use and protocol compatibility remain unproved.

scope: Frontend and synthetic directory snapshots only
unknowns: Official Files menu-to-service owner and capability predicates
Official file resource retrieval and preview presentation
Exact row icons, title generation, fonts, insets, colors, corner radius, presentation detents
Physical device behavior and Android native host
validation: Foundation passed. Two directory journeys passed in r4. Three shared preview/diff regression cases passed in r1.
restored_structure: FileBrowserSheet -> FileNavigationStack -> DirectoryContent -> Header + plain List -> plain row Button with Label and opening progress
separate_branch: WorkspaceBrowserContent uses ScrollView/LazyVStack/DisclosureGroup and does not prove the ordinary Files directory layout.
independent_adaptations: Native phone NavigationStack, system folder/document glyphs and default spacing
Synthetic provider IDs and request lifecycle; isolated full-file QuickLook resource ownership
Synthetic path/provenance header and localized unavailable/empty/retry copy

cross_platform.shared_proposal: Scoped directory/file contracts and deterministic test vectors
cross_platform.official_shared_evidence: Not established by this iOS-only trace
cross_platform.platform_owned: Navigation, scroll, QuickLook, material, Dynamic Type, keyboard and lifecycle
